import json, os, platform, math
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib import font_manager
from PIL import Image

with open(src, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    d=json.load(f)

font_path="/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"
bold_path="/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Bold.ttc"
font_name=font_manager.FontProperties(fname=font_path).get_name()
matplotlib.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": font_name, "font.size": 12, "axes.unicode_minus": False,
    "mathtext.default":"regular", "figure.facecolor":"white", "axes.facecolor":"white",
    "savefig.facecolor":"white"
})
W,H=2400,1600; dpi=300
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(W/dpi,H/dpi),dpi=dpi,facecolor="white")
fig.canvas.draw()
renderer=fig.canvas.get_renderer()
fp=font_manager.FontProperties(fname=font_path,size=12)
bfp=font_manager.FontProperties(fname=bold_path,size=12)

def wrap_by_pixels(s, max_px, renderer, prop):
    lines=[]
    current=""
    for ch in s:
        if ch == "\n":
            lines.append(current); current=""; continue
        trial=current+ch
        w,_,_=renderer.get_text_width_height_descent(trial,prop,ismath=False)
        if current and w > max_px:
            lines.append(current)
            current=ch
        else:
            current=trial
    lines.append(current)
    return "\n".join(lines)

ax=fig.add_axes([0.15,0.49,0.78,0.31])
effects=d["effects"]; ys=list(range(len(effects)))[::-1]; color="#0173B2"
ref=d["plot_config"]["reference_line"]
ax.axvline(ref,color="#666666",ls="--",lw=1.2,zorder=1)
for yi,e in zip(ys,effects):
    est=e["estimate"]; lo=e.get("ci_low"); hi=e.get("ci_high")
    if lo is not None and hi is not None:
        ax.errorbar(est,yi,xerr=[[est-lo],[hi-est]],fmt="o",color=color,ecolor=color,
                    elinewidth=2,capsize=5,markersize=7,markeredgecolor="white",markeredgewidth=.8,zorder=3)
    else:
        ax.plot(est,yi,"o",color=color,markersize=7,zorder=3)
ylabs=[e["label"]+(f" ({e['unit']})" if e.get("unit") else "") for e in effects]
ax.set_yticks(ys); ax.set_yticklabels(ylabs)
px=d["presentation"]["axes"]["x"]; py=d["presentation"]["axes"]["y"]
xlab=px["label"]+(f" ({px['unit']})" if px["unit"] else "")
ylab=py["label"]+(f" ({py['unit']})" if py["unit"] else "")
ax.set_xlabel(xlab,labelpad=9); ax.set_ylabel(ylab,labelpad=18)
vals=[ref]+[v for e in effects for v in [e.get("estimate"),e.get("ci_low"),e.get("ci_high")] if v is not None]
vmin,vmax=min(vals),max(vals); span=vmax-vmin; pad=max(span*.12,.2)
ax.set_xlim(vmin-pad,vmax+pad); ax.set_ylim(-.65,max(ys)+.65)
ax.grid(axis="x",color="#D9D9D9",lw=.8,alpha=.8)
ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False); ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)

title_t=fig.text(.5,.925,d["labels"]["title"],ha="center",va="center",fontproperties=bfp)
n_t=fig.text(.15,.835,f"n = {d['sample_count']}",ha="left",va="center",fontproperties=fp)
ci_t=fig.text(.15,.405,"95%置信区间",ha="left",va="center",color=color,fontproperties=fp,
              bbox=dict(boxstyle="square,pad=0.25",facecolor="white",edgecolor=color,lw=1))

cap_wrapped=wrap_by_pixels(d["labels"]["caption"], W*.84, renderer, fp)
cap_t=fig.text(.08,.315,cap_wrapped,ha="left",va="top",linespacing=1.35,fontproperties=fp)
abbr="；".join(f"{x['term']}：{x['definition']}" for x in d["presentation"]["abbreviations"])
abbr_wrapped=wrap_by_pixels(abbr,W*.84,renderer,fp)
abbr_t=fig.text(.08,.135,abbr_wrapped,ha="left",va="top",linespacing=1.35,fontproperties=fp)

fig.canvas.draw(); renderer=fig.canvas.get_renderer()
# bounds and pairwise overlaps among key explanatory regions
key=[("title",title_t),("n",n_t),("ci",ci_t),("caption",cap_t),("abbr",abbr_t),
     ("xlabel",ax.xaxis.label),("ylabel",ax.yaxis.label)]
bounds={name:t.get_window_extent(renderer) for name,t in key}
issues=[]
for name,bb in bounds.items():
    if bb.x0<0 or bb.y0<0 or bb.x1>W or bb.y1>H:
        issues.append(("bounds",name,tuple(map(float,bb.bounds))))
for i in range(len(key)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(key)):
        n1,t1=key[i]; n2,t2=key[j]
        if bounds[n1].overlaps(bounds[n2]):
            issues.append(("overlap",n1,n2))
            
fig.savefig(out_png,dpi=dpi,facecolor="white",edgecolor="none")
plt.close(fig)
img=Image.open(out_png)
img.size, issues, cap_wrapped, abbr_wrapped
from IPython.display import display
display(Image.open("/mnt/data/figure.png").resize((1200,800)))
# Final validation
with open("/mnt/data/result.json",encoding="utf-8") as f:
    r=json.load(f, parse_constant=lambda x: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(x)))
assert r["schema_version"]==5

assert r["presentation"]==d["presentation"]
assert r["legacy_contract"]==d["legacy_contract"]
assert Image.open("/mnt/data/figure.png").size==(2400,1600)
print("validated")
